description: Figure out whether 'the ick' about someone you're dating is a real incompatibility, a genuine red flag, or an anxious/avoidant self-sabotage pattern worth pushing through — by interrogating the specific ick honestly. Use when someone says 'I caught the ick and I don't know why', 'is this a red flag or am I just scared', 'I always find a reason to end things', or is talking themselves out of someone good. Honest self-reflection, not a permission slip in either direction.
